name: reply-markdown
description: Draws a reply's headings, lists, quotes, callouts, tables and rules in color, with copy buttons for tables, callouts and code cards (terminal)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn this mod off without removing it. Takes effect at once.

headings.title: Headings
headings.description: Draw headings in color, a level 1 heading as a badge. Off, the engine draws them.

lists.title: Lists
lists.description: Draw bullets and numbers in color, and task items as checkboxes. Off, the engine draws lists, and Claude is not told to write task lists.

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.description: Draw a quote with a colored bar beside it. Off, the engine draws it.

callouts.title: Callouts
callouts.description: Draw a GitHub alert (> [!WARNING] and the rest) as a box in its color, with a button that copies its Markdown source. Off, the engine draws it as a quote, and Claude is not told to write alerts.

tables.title: Tables
tables.description: Draw a table with the lines the table border option names, with a button that copies its Markdown source. Off, the engine draws it.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Draw a horizontal rule as a line across the reply. Off, the engine draws it.

codeCards.title: Code cards
codeCards.description: Put a code fence in a card with a copy button. Off, the engine draws it, and Claude is not told to put what the user will copy in a fence of its own.

tableBorder.title: Table border
tableBorder.description: The lines of a table. rules: no frame, a line under the header and a faint one between the rows. round: a frame of thin lines, rounded corners. single: thin lines, square corners. bold: thick lines, square corners. Thick lines cannot have rounded corners: no such characters exist.

cardBorder.title: Card and callout border
cardBorder.description: The border of a code card and of a callout box. round: thin lines, rounded corners. single: thin lines, square corners. bold: thick lines, square corners.
